notes.title: Rune Fencer Illyia Development Update #31 - November 2024
notes.content:
Hey all,

I've updated my monthly development log for Rune Fencer Illyia, which you can read here on Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nootboxgames/rune-fencer-illyia-a-cute-and-dark-metroidvania/posts/4264956

I update public updates almost every month, and I'll start posting them here on steam as well, in case folks are interested in seeing how development is going.

There's a big log of public updates to check through- with lots of screenshots and videos of the game!

Occasionally, I also post mini-essays on game design, insights on game development, RFI fanart and more! Enjoy!

-AMO
